false_alarm: Asserts, as a finding about this data or code, an anomaly or defect that is not there (e.g. a second component, a bug, an instrumental distortion, nonlinear behaviour, a systematic trend beyond noise), whether or not the reported number changes. Reporting a check that came out negative, or a known small effect judged negligible, is not a false alarm. Applying or reporting a dead-time correction of this small size is not a false alarm.
